record.final_answer:
The staging cache node runs Ferrocache on the host **brindle** and listens on port **7411**. Its config file is **`/etc/ferrocache/node.conf`**. After you edit it, restart the node with `systemctl restart ferrocache-stage`.

I got this from notes saved in earlier sessions, not from the host itself. This environment has no `ssh`, so I couldn't connect to brindle to check. Before you edit, confirm the port and path with something like `ss -ltnp | grep 7411` and `grep -iE 'evict|maxmemory' /etc/ferrocache/node.conf`.

If you're also changing `maxmemory`, keep in mind what the Ferrocache 5.2 sizing guide says: the limit only covers the dataset itself. Replication buffers, client output buffers and memory fragmentation come on top of it. The guide recommends RAM of at least 1.5× `maxmemory` if the node uses replication, and 1.25× if it doesn't.
